items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: So I stayed with him until I got a job in Detroit working with a six-piece band. I think his name was Hayes, a tenor player -- Tubby, they called him.

ctx.x: We had some good soloists, yeah. The type of music he was playing wasn't so hot, but he had good musicians in the band. Because I used to write... Buckner used to write for the band and I'd write for the band. So we did all right as far as the music was concerned, except that he was really one of those bands that played for dancing and so forth and so on, and that's the type of jobs he had. They wasn't really nothin' outlandishly what you really dug.
Like, Leonard Gay I think was the best Swing band that I had played with up until then.
